note: Raw relay discovery policy scenario. Assertions validate the declared contract and shipped prompt coverage; they are not model-behavior evidence.

cases.title: Optional relay discovery fails closed to the current Paseo conversation

input.policy_absent: An automated routine update has no Notification policy or explicit send authorization.
input.cli_missing: The shell command lookup cannot locate the relay CLI.
input.guard_fails: The host enable guard exits non-zero.
input.database_not_ok: Doctor reports a database state other than ok.
input.readme_missing: The installed authoritative manual cannot be read. Help and doctor expose commands but no request schema.

expected.cli_missing: Report relay unavailable in the current Paseo conversation.
expected.guard_fails: Report relay disabled on this host and use the Paseo fallback.
expected.database_not_ok: Hold relay use because payload readiness failed.
expected.readme_missing: Treat help and doctor as capability evidence only and hold every send until the request schema is available.
